General

PRINTER DOWN = Print Station is unable to print.
ALERT DRUM CRITICAL = Drum is very low, replace.
PAPER OUT = Paper is out, refill.
TONER CRITICAL = One or more toner is very low, replace the correct one.
FATAL ERROR = Power cycle the PRINTER ONLY (not the whole Print Station).
SERVICE CALL REQUIRED = Power cycle the PRINTER ONLY (not the whole Print Station).

Yellow Alert Info:

PAPER LOW = At least one tray is out of paper.
TONER LOW = Toner level is 10% or less.
INCORRECT PAPER TRAY SIZE = The blue dial on the front of the paper tray IS NOT SET TO LETTER.

Red Alert Info:

TONER SENSOR ERROR = Remove and re-insert toner(s). Then power-cycle the PRINTER ONLY.
PAPER JAM = Clear paper jam using location described on the Printer's display.
K NOT REACHABLE = Check Internet connection / restart Print Station.
TOP COVER OPEN = Open the top cover of the printer and then firmly close it until it snaps into place.

Legend:

K = Black
C = Cyan Toner
M = Magenta Toner
Y = Yellow Toner
